name: Shiori
message: "Is it just me, or...?"

name: Shiori
message: "No... it's really there. A red envelope... and it's so easy to spot, like it wants to be found."

name: Shiori
message: "So it just comes back, huh... I guess there was no point in taking it back with us."

name: Shiori
message: "...I know it's a bit late to say this, but... isn't this town way too dangerous?"

name: Shiori
message: "There are ghosts everywhere... thought-forms... and even urban legends that straight up kill you, just lying around..."

name: Shiori
message: "Will this town really be okay? It's sketchy enough that I'd believe it if someone told me some messed-up ritual happened here in the past..."
(Tell her what you heard from the deity)

name: Shiori
message: "Huh... so it's always been this way. The deity's power weakened, the balance between this world and the next started to collapse, and the boundary grew hazy... I see..."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? Is that really okay?"

name: Shiori
message: "If the deity's power doesn't come back, won't this town eventually turn into some kind of netherworld...?"

name: Shiori
message: "Isn't that kinda... no, REALLY bad...? This place is slowly marching toward ruin..."

name: Shiori
message: "But... because of that, I got to meet you. If I'd died in some other town, I might've just quietly passed on."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, but Ms. Librarian probably isn't even from here, right? Maybe you really can't pass on if you have regrets or fixations."

name: Shiori
message: "Even so, I still think I met you thanks to this town's bizarre nature."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, I was trying to end that on a nice note, but no, I just can't. This town's way too scary..."

name: Shiori
message: "You should definitely move away... It feels like you could get dragged into some spiritual realm at any moment... Please, do watch out, okay?"

name: Shiori
message: "Actually, there's even a threat right in front of us, something you're definitely not supposed to pick up."

name: Shiori
message: "We should go before you decide to pick it up on a whim."
